title: Silver Needle — Pilot engagement notes
content:
Quick scratchpad for Silver Needle (mid-market retail chain) — assembling outreach and pilot approach. Really messy notes, do not share externally yet.

Account snapshot:
- Company: Silver Needle Retail (regional chain, ~45 stores + ecommerce). HQ: Portland. Tech: on-prem POS + AWS storefront; experience team of ~12 engineers; data + analytics centralized.
- Why they matter: Heavy personalization use-case; already experimenting with recommendations and search relevancy. If they standardize on an inference platform, could expand to cart assistants, customer support automation, and product discovery.
- Initial signal: Mentioned in a webinar (Sep 2023) that latency spikes happen during flash sales; CTO was on panel. Pricing sensitivity but willing to pilot.

Hypothesis / thesis for outreach:
- Silver Needle needs predictable inference economics during peak events while keeping control over customer data. Redwood provides: predictable reserved capacity (Dedicated) + private deployment options for PII-sensitive flows. Emphasize: low-latency (tail SLOs), KV/prefix caching to cut token cost, and can failover to hosted API in bursts.

Key contacts (to confirm):
- Lina Torres — Head of Product (retail recommendations) — linkedin/???, attended webinar.
- Mateo Ruiz — Eng manager (platform) — possible gatekeeper for infra decisions.
- Priya Shah — Head of Data Science — influencer for model quality and evals.
- Sales contact: outreach to Lina first, loop Mateo on technical thread.

Background research notes:
- Tech blog post from Apr 2023: they built a homegrown recommendation microservice on ECS; no GPU infra in-house.
- Job postings: 2 infra hires in past 6 months (sign they want reliability/scale).
- Privacy/regulatory: they store limited PII; primary concern is customer purchase history used for personalization.

Integration & risk map (brainstorm):
- Data path: Likely want embeddings for product catalog + real-time user context. Ask about where embeddings live, refresh cadence.
- Auth & keys: If Private deployment, need KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 notes. If Dedicated, show quick onboarding path with VPC peering.
- Latency: requirement = <120ms p95 for assistant replies during checkout. Need to validate token lengths and typical sequences — ask Priya for distribution.
- Failure modes: flash sale burst. Recommend: Dedicated + autoscaleable burst pool + routing policy to hosted fallback.

Pilot proposal (3-tier options):
- Option A (low friction): Hosted API test for 30 days, sample integration on staging storefront, run A/B personalizations for search suggestions. Goals: validate quality lift and baseline p50 latency. OK for product team but not ideal for data/infra.
- Option B (recommended): 6-week Dedicated pilot (small reserved pool) attached to their AWS region, with KV caching set up for catalog prefixes. Deliverables: latency report, token cost breakdown, quality delta vs current model, simple canary rollback flow. Pricing: trial credits + discounted commit.
- Option C (private): VPC/private control plane proof-of-concept — 8–10 weeks, includes KMS integration, audit logs, and on-prem model pinning. Scope if they require data isolation or compliance.

Success metrics to propose in pilot:
- Latency: p95 <= 120ms for typical assistant flow (checkout recs).
- Cost: per-session token cost reduction target 20% vs baseline using caching & batching.
- Quality: Lift in click-through on recommended items by +6–10% in experiment window.
- Reliability: 99.9% uptime for trial traffic.

Objections & quick rebuttals (prep):
- \"We can't send customer data offsite\": Offer Private deployment + KMS/HSM + audit logs; propose staged approach (metadata-only to hosted, then private PoC).
- \"We already have a recommendations system\": Stress model quality + latency at scale + lower ops overhead. Show case study where model rollout + rollbacks saved ops time.
- \"Pricing is unclear / too expensive\": Present cost model: committed Dedicated baseline vs burst routing; show unit economics and caching reductions. Offer pilot credits and a clear path to predictable billing.
- \"Lock-in concerns\": Emphasize ability to pin model versions, export logs, and standard API layer — portability.

Outbound drafts (two variants):
- Email A (concise):
  Subject: Quick idea for Silver Needle’s personalization during flash sales
  Hi Lina — caught your webinar on scaling personalization — quick note: we help teams keep recommendation latency predictable during peaks while reducing per-token cost via caching and dedicated pools. Can I share a 1-page pilot plan that runs in your staging AWS region and shows latency/cost savings in 4–6 weeks?
  —Maya
- Email B (value-first with data):
  Subject: Pilot to cut recommendation latency and token cost by ~20%
  Hi Lina — we ran a Dedicated pilot with a similar retailer and cut p95 latency from 260ms to 95ms and lowered per-session token cost by ~24% using KV caching + small reserved capacity. Happy to share the experiment plan and KPIs — open to a 20-min call next week?
  
Call script bullets (first intro 10–12 min):
1) Quick one-sentence intro (who we are — Redwood Inference, inference platform: hosted/dedicated/private).
2) Confirm pain: flash sale latency, ops overhead, model rollout risk?
3) Walk a short narrative: sample pilot flow (Option B) — what we configure, what we measure.
4) Ask technical question: typical sequence lengths, percent of requests hitting same prefixes, where embeddings are stored.
5) Agree on next step: share 1-pager + schedule intro with Mateo & Priya.

Notes on pricing approach to test in pilot conversation:
- Offer 6-week discounted Dedicated pilot: modest commit (e.g., 2–4 GPU-equivalents) with trial credits, cost transparency dashboard, and a clearly documented cost-per-1000-tokens estimate with caching assumptions.
- If move to Private, quote platform fee + support; prepare SOW template.

Metrics/data to request early (for sizing & SLOs):
- Typical request qps + peak qps during promotions.
- Avg and 95th token lengths per session.
- % of requests that re-use same prefix (for caching impact).
- Current ops team size and uptime expectations.

Immediate next steps (TODOs):
- [ ] Find Lina Torres email and confirm webinar timestamp (Jordan).
- [ ] Draft 1-pager (Aisha) — include pilot options, expected timelines + success metrics.
- [ ] Prepare quick cost model template with caching assumptions (me) — include sample numbers for 2/4/8 GPU-equivalent pilots.
- [ ] Ask legal for Private deployment KMS checklist (link doc).

Open questions to resolve on first call:
- Do they require data residency (EU-only) or any contractual data restrictions?
- Who signs SOW — product or corporate procurement? Expected procurement lead time?
- Is there an existing GPU budget or appetite to spike for a pilot?

Misc scribbles / links for follow up:
- internal case study: retail-flash-sale-jan2024 (ask product for lift numbers)
- Slack thread: #pilot-opps (tag Mateo when we get time windows)

Rough timeline sketch for Option B (recommended):
Week 0: Kickoff + access requests.
Week 1–2: Small Dedicated pool + test traffic, configure KV caching and canary.
Week 3–4: Run A/B on staging -> measure latency & CTR.
Week 5–6: Wrap report + handoff to infra for production plan.

End notes: keep this light, try to secure Lina meeting first and treat Mateo/Priya as technical blockers. Prioritize landing the Recommended pilot (Option B) but keep Hosted option as lowest-friction backstop.

(Internal: save this as a working doc — will produce a cleaned 1-pager and a formal pilot SOW draft if we get initial signal.)
